title: Steeltime Our Father Prayer Spinner Ring, Size 10, Silver

writeup: Woot has the Steeltime Our Father prayer spinner ring in silver, size 10, for $4.99. It's stainless steel with a spinning center band engraved with the Lord's Prayer, and it's nickel-free. Steeltime's own shop sells the same ring for $18 and Target sellers list it at $21.59, so this is about 72% less. Woot shows 10+ left with a limit of 10 per customer.
